text_chunks:
Job Description 
 
Job title 
Junior UX Designer 
Reports to 
UX Architect 
Experience 
0 to 2 years 
 
Job purpose 
 
• To research, study, analyze, document, present and design delightful & 
functional experience for the target users across all possible digital mediums.  
 
Duties and responsibilities 
 
• Must be an excellent visualizer and analyst. 
• Should be able to Map User Journeys, User Flows & Design Information 
architecture of applications across devices. 
• Should be able to observe, research, analyze and Design an experience across 
devices. 
• Analyze and bring out actionable insights and details from available research 
data & research. 
• Create personas, use cases, understand & Document requirements, mind maps, 
site maps, and High fid / Low Fid wireframes 
• Collaborate with Business Analysts to refine the Business requirements 
• Collaborate with Visual Designer to bring out the optimal visual experience. 
• Collaborate with UI Developer to bring out optimal functional experience. 
• Conduct Usability Testing 
• Review the application for optimal experience at various points to provide course 
correction. 
 
 
Qualifications 
 
 
• B.Des. / M.Des. / Diploma in User Experience Design from a reputed Institutes 
• Psychology knowledge or certification will be a value add 
• Excellent spoken and written English 
• Good understanding of user research techniques, documentation, questioners, 
system study, gap analysis. 
• Good sketching skills 
• Excellent design skills in interactive and functional interaction design. 
• Previous experience with a Leading Design firm having exposure working with 
Global clients will be preferred.

Working conditions 
 
Work requires a lot of interpersonal collaboration and coordination. So excellent 
communication and interactive skill are a must. Must be a good team player.  
 
Software Knowledge 
 
• Axure 
• Adobe XD 
• Figma 
• Sketch 
• InVision Studio 
• Other tools like Affinity Designer, Dreamweaver, After Effects, Adobe Animate 
would be added advantage.
